name: month_end_by_status_demo
source_sql: SELECT h.status_cd AS STATUS_CD, COUNT(*) AS INVOICE_COUNT, SUM(h.total_amt) AS HEADER_TOTAL_AMT FROM invoice_header h WHERE h.batch_no = 85559852 GROUP BY h.status_cd

name: month_end_by_status_line_type_demo
source_sql: SELECT h.status_cd AS STATUS_CD, l.line_type_cd AS LINE_TYPE_CD, COUNT(*) AS LINE_COUNT, SUM(l.amount) AS LINE_AMOUNT, SUM(l.tax_amt) AS LINE_TAX, COUNT(DISTINCT h.invoice_id) AS INVOICES_TOUCHED FROM invoice_header h, invoice_line l WHERE h.batch_no = 85559852 AND h.invoice_id = l.invoice_id GROUP BY h.status_cd, l.line_type_cd

name: custbill_scope_demo
source_sql: SELECT h.invoice_id AS INVOICE_ID, h.cust_id AS CUST_ID, TO_DATE(h.invoice_dt, 'DD-MON-RR') AS PERIOD_END, h.total_amt AS TOTAL_AMT, CASE WHEN h.total_amt < 0 THEN '02' ELSE '01' END AS RECORD_TYPE FROM invoice_header h WHERE h.batch_no = 85559852 OR h.tenant_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
